name: pcp
description: Pre-call prep: a few one-time setup questions, research from public sources (plus LinkedIn through your browser and your own files, when you allow it), and ONE 3-page PDF: a 2-page Intelligence Brief and a 1-page meeting script. Every fact cited.

interface.shortDescription: One cited Intelligence Brief and meeting script before any call
interface.longDescription: Sets up once, then researches the person, company or deal you are about to meet from public sources, LinkedIn through your browser and your own files when you allow it, and renders one 3-page PDF: a 2-page Intelligence Brief and a 1-page meeting script. Every fact carries a source; what it could not find becomes a question to ask in the room.
defaultPrompt: Prep me for my call with Jane Doe at Acme Capital.
